The Planner incorrectly interpreted "20.87 万" as "20.87 million" (20,870,000). Consequently, the final conclusion that Hanggin Rear Banner has a larger population than Shanghai (24.87 million) is factually incorrect. Shanghai's population is significantly larger than Hanggin Rear Banner's actual population of ~209,000.
